This was one of the best games i've ever played!

The story, the gameplay, the cooperation inbetween Pc and the game, the characters etc.
I really liked the start of the game, it was a good introduction to the whole game. I liked it how the first puzzle was that you had to figure out the pc password with the remote.
The story that the 'sun' is extinguished and you have to bring a new one to the top was a very good idea. Aswell as the whole story devoleps after time.
The gameplay was very simple and clear. You can get stuff on the way and you can combine it.
The cooperation inbetween the Pc and the game was awsome and i've never seen it before! I want more of those kind of games.
Every kind of character in this game were nice and everyone of them is memorable. My personal favorite character was Niko obviously but still i liked them!
I know that this game has multiple endings but i just finished one of them. Gotta finish or see them all.

I really want more of these kind of games! I enjoyed it alot and i can say it was worth the money. I'm going to recommend it to any of my friends if it's a topic.
I really have no negativ for this game, it was too awesome.

Play this game!

I usually get stuck in the endless replayability loop of shooters ir sandbox games, but wow, this game is incredible. It pulls you in and make you think like you are a part of the world. The characters are lovable, and I found myself kind of following the emotions of Niko, as weird as it may seem. The puzzles arent too difficult although some can be a bit vague. The story is interesting with every turn you learn something new. You really have to read every paper and nite lying around to get the bigger picture. You make an interesting bond with Niko as he knows you are real. But so does the game itself. Usually i just blandly play games while getting almost nothing out of it, but after playing this game, so many emotions are running through my head. 13 out of 10. Im going to base the rest of my life around this game.

OneShot is beautiful. There's no excuse not to play. I can't put into words how good this game is.

Just play it, and know that the game doesn't end after 100% achievements.

OneShot is one of the most surreal games I have ever played, making me question my actions just as much if not more than "Undertale." Interacting with and being spoken to directly by the protagonist feels very profound. I was originally concerned by the need to use the computer outside of the game because I can't code, but no coding is required. It is more like a Scavenger hunt for files and pictures. That being said, do not try to delete your save file via your documents, you will only destroy documents crucial to completing the game.

Truly a unique experience, unlike any other. I really can't share much of what I enjoyed about the game, because those feelings of discovery and realizations were so satisfying. I wouldn't want to take that away from anyone. Just do yourself a favour and give this game a playthrough!
Please for the love of God play this game the story telling us amazing the only true way is to go in blind and just experience it 10/10 an honor playing this game

be warned. OneShot pretends to be cute and then emotionally dropkicks you.

It plays with the fourth wall without really ever breaking it. Some puzzles feel eeringly personal.

Highly recommended if you enjoy (and are capable of handling) feelings.
You don’t just play OneShot.. You experience it and then you're forced to wave goodbye.

yes bruh, this game changed my life 4 years ago, still affects my life to this day, super peak, go buy it

seriously though, this game actually changed my life, back when i got it in 2022 i was going through some serious mental health stuff, but playing this and getting the true ending is a experience ill never forget, saved me from what i was going through by giving me a new presective on stuff and helped me recover, still miss ya niko :steamcry:

10/10, defo get if you have the money

Fantastic game! The music is incredible, the writing is super cute and the characters are amazing. the story and puzzles are also top notch. 10/10

Edit: I do gotta say with how my taste in games has evolved since i wrote this review giving oneshot a 10 feels a little unfair to some other games, but its still a great time

This game is so amazing. The story and the characters feel like they were put together with so much love and thought, and the way the game speaks directly to the player feels so unique and makes your decisions so much more impactful. 10/10 would 100% recommend.

This game is such a unique experience and utilizes the medium so well to tell a truly memorable and heartfelt story. There's nothing quite like it, and you owe it to yourself to see it through to the end.

I just finished it and... wow. I think this is probably one of the most emotional games I've played in recent memory. Something that I've really enjoyed was just how it takes what Undertale does with it's 4th wall breaks, and just expands upon it. If you're someone that loves Undertale, or other games like it, then you WILL love this one. I cannot recommend this more highly enough, so please give it a shot with your own blind playthrough!

What an a s tounding game.

OneShot isn't your typical adventure puzzle game. It feels and plays a lot like Undertale (without the battle elements), but the m o st striking thing about OneShot is that the game essentially doesn't have a fourth wall. If you're unsure what that means... you'll have to play the game yourse l f to find out. The absence of the fourth wall caught me off guard at some points early on, but also allows for s ome creative out-of-the-box gameplay (literally) and story that I was utterly amazed with and I never thought would be possible in any video game. I t 's beautiful.
Fantastic plot, writing, great music. I also find Niko a really cute character (still convinced he/she i s a cat), further adding to the game's appeal.

If you're okay with unexpe c ted things to happen to your PC while playing, I very much recommend OneShot. Go g e t and play it.

This is a pretty fun game.
Having some really interesting concept, the music is pretty calming and emotional.
The most interesting thing about it, is it's 4th wall breaking-- it knows YOU are controlling it. (this isn't inspired from Undertale, which came after)

God. Um. Okay. Where to start?
This is a great game. Very deep, very emotional. It gives you a moral choice, and it gives you more out of it than you think. Solstice was... so damn good. I've cried.
10/10. Won't replay again because I would die if I did. It's that good.
Thanks for my life.

OneShot.
I haven't heard of this game untill February or March 2017. I heard of it from Markiplier, then after watching the first part of his playthrough, I quickly got on Steam and bought it.

OneShot is a "surreal top down Puzzle/Adventure game" as it says in the description. You play as a child named Niko, who is lost in a strange world on a mission to revive its long-dead sun. I have to say that when I played this, I felt like I was connecting with Niko, as Niko does talk and interact with you. When the game ended, I kinda cried inside. Undertale did the magic when it came to connecting with the characters, but OneShot did it even better. I always wish I could forget all of the time I played and play it blindly again, just so I can experience it again. And for the OST and sound effects, it is amazing. They all sound so nice and perfect. It was beyond my expectations. WAY beyond and I love it.

10/10 from me. This game is $9.99 USD, and if you love having your emotions tugged around, buy this and play this. I promise you, you will love it.

Also Niko is an adorable cat.

This is one of my favorite games of all time. The characters are all so compelling and recognizable. The world building is incredible. The story is like no other and the integration with the players own computer system is really immersive. I highly recommend this to anyone looking for a cute, easy to play game with deeper meanings and morally difficult choices.l

An absolute master class in writing and subverting expectations, I enjoyed OneShot immensely. I believe the "update" they put in really completed the game and brang it all together. If you think it's finally over, make sure to check everything! It's a great game, and I recommend it to everyone! It made me cry like a fucking child.
This game is just genuinely a masterpiece, when I say this game will change your life, I MEAN IT. Especially go for the Solstice ending!

This game... this game... it's something. It's a fantastic game, probably my favorite indie game ever, potentially favorite game ever. It has well-crafted puzzles, a good soundtrack, and one of my favorite plots in a video game ever. This game is a must have, the game would still be worth it even if the price was over double what it is normally.

Ok wow, so, first of all there are reasons this game has a 98% review rating. This game is a tour de force of an experience. I legitimately thought I was done being emotionally touched by games, this proved me wrong. Beyond the narrative however, mechanically the game is honestly fascinating. Without getting into spoilers, expect the unexpected. Undertale might have played with the 'game/world' space at a few times, but this takes it to a whole new level.

The adventure game mechanics are lovely here too, and I strongly encourage players to avoid using walkthroughs whenever possible. Ask around, the NPCs give plenty of hints.

Also the graphics/music are extremely aesthetically pleasing.

Definitely check this game out.

Wonderful game, it doesn't resist to control your emotions and not once does it fail on making you cry, laugh, or get angry. It breaks the forth wall, but in a way such that turns something that would usually make the game worse, into something that makes the game perfected. It is nothing but amazing. and if you can afford it, yet refuse to buy it, I'd like you to immediately seek help, as you will be making the worst choice of your entire life.

And as you know... You only have one shot. Don't waste it.

Incredible. Absolutely incredible. You know how Undertale is one of those games that is better the less you know about it? It's the same thing with this game. I don't think my words can really put much justice into this game. My advice would be to just buy it and play it on a whim. You won't regret doing so.

I recommend everyone play this game. Even being simplistic in gameplay, it delivers a great story, makes you care about characters of the world, and offers clever puzzles. It is a little disappointing to see one of the endings from the original version gone, but otherwise, it's a very memorable and touching experience.

I absolutely loved this game!!! There's honestly too much to write about to fully explain how pleased I am with this game, so I'm going to keep it relatively short.
If you like cats, animals, and nature, along with mystery, suspense, puzzles and futuristic vibes, this game is for YOU! Funny enough, the main character, Niko (the cat looking child), and the "god" (which is you), share the same name, Niko. It's pretty funny because my name is also Niko! It kind of made the experience 10x more interesting, and also really attaching.
This game also has a lot to do with your real life computer! It frequently breaks the forth wall, which is so cool, and has you manipulate things outside the actual game to progress. Without spoiling anything, some features include looking through your files in your documents folder, moving the game window around, changing your desktop background, and more. Such a surreal experience for such a small game.
You GOTTA try this game for yourself! It is a must play for anyone who likes indie games and puzzles!
ALSO, after playing the Solstice addition, I must say, please don't forget about it. It was a truly amazing experience!

3. Don't read anymore reviews after this one as it might ruin your experience.

What do you get when combining a powerful theme with impeccable execution? An unforgettable masterpice.
Also, just in case anyone is apprehensive about playing as a little cat person, I'll clarify "you" are not Niko (the protagonist) in this story, and that you play as yourself.

10/10 story, great music, cute characters and visuals.
Terrible level design. Way too much walking and pointless rooms/spaces.
Jaw dropping ending.
Mixed bag
I can't say why Oneshot is one of my favorite games of all time, because it would ruin the magic.

This has changed many lives, including mine. I see this not as a game, but as a connection to a different world. Sure the world is simulated but it is not fake. I still remember the day I stepped into this world, it makes me want to start over again, but not really, try out the world and you'll understand what I mean.

-Be me
-Expecting a cute little adventure story
-Istead, I get hit with one of the most absorbing, emotional, and thoughtful journeys that's going to stick with me for a good while

PS

I hope Niko gets all the pancakes

I cant even describe how much this game means to me

Just the characters, the world and the soundtrack, Niko himself, It all merges together in this beautiful game.

Its just such a wonderfully made game and has made me tear up multiple times through it.

Cat feet/10 would recommend

One of a kind adventure with great story, beautiful soundtrack, characters that feel alive and you only get one shot.. I miss you Niko, but wherever you are now I hope you are happy and get to eat lots of those tasty pancakes

10/10
An absolutely amazing game, beautiful soundtrack and visuals, and most of all, such an incredible story, that puts a concept of breaking the fourth wall to the next level. Such a gem of a game!

A clever adventure game that develops a charming relationship between player and player character. Much of what I liked about Undertale is also present in OneShot. And it has the best use of the fourth wall I've ever seen. Innovative, well-written, and fun.

Words cannot fully express how this game made me feel. I was so beautifully crafted, hearing the hope from countless characters, and personally getting to know the main character. No other game I have played has achieved this, and because of this, I have never gotten more attached to a single character than I did to Niko.

The puzzles can be challenging, and I can almost guarantee you that in the end, you will shed tears. Give this masterpiece of a game a shot, and please, be kind to little Niko <3

I haven't felt so emotionally attached to a video game and it's characters for a very long time. I suppressed the urge to cry while playing this masterpiece of a game. Oneshot is a phenomenal experience and I think everyone should try it.

And to the developers who put this together, I wish you the absolute best and I hope you know how many people's lives you've positively influenced with this amazing piece of work. You're fantastic people. Much love and appreciation. <3

5/28/2024 Edit
A few months ago I finally convinced one of my friends to play this game and they screenshared it over Discord so I could watch, and they enjoyed it a lot. I still tear up. This game is extraordinarily beautiful. Thank you, Devs. I know literally no one will read this review but I hope at least the creators know how much I appreciate this wonderful game.
A wholesome and unique RPG adventure game. It's quite short but I can't *not* recommend it. Play through it sometime when life has you down
At whatever cost, do not miss this game before you die. It's only like 15 hours of gameplay, but you will be infinite lives richer.

One of the best games I played. It's quality of story is comparable with Bastion's and originality is on a whole new level. I would highly recommend it to anyone who has a bit of patience and maybe don't look up all the solutions to the puzzles because they're simple but require you to think outside the box.

I bought this game for less than what it costs to get a sandwich. After a few hours of gameplay, it became one one of the most emotionally resonating games I have ever played. It's simple and the playthroughs are relatively short, but the fourth-wall breaking and out-of-game-window puzzles make the game memorable and fun. This game is best experienced blind, not knowing how it will end. Undertale made me laugh. Oneshot made me cry. Definitely worth a shot (or two.) 10/10 game in my opinion.

My most favourite game of all time.
(No detailed professional review here, this game is just great!)

I have heard it said before but I will say it again and anyone who has played this game will likely say the same. This isn't a game, this is an experience. The only game where it feels like I can not just communicate with the main character of the game but if there wasn't boundaries to stop it, I could have a full on conversation. Goodness sake, I don't even really see them as a character, I see them as a true, honest to God friend. That is what this game does
Genuinely made me cry. 10/10 game, I wish my memory got wiped so I could experience this game again for the first time.
possibly the best story ive ever had the grace of experiencing, a game you TRULY dont want to lose out on, a piece of modern storytelling at its best, it deserves all the love it gets.

One of the best games ive ever played hands down. With the best character design, story elements, puzzles, and best of all- the fact that you dont do they same puzzle as 42 different games. This game quite literally changed my life, this game would be worth it if it was as much as gta6. :3

Fantastic game, but a fair warning if you play on Linux like me, it won’t work on Linux. The world machine edition seems like it would work since it has steam deck compatibility but I haven’t tried that yet.

Do we live in a simulation? I guess this is a question everybody has done and the response is probably "no" but the characters of this game, the characters of any game, actually, think the same, that they are living beeings, so i think a more interesting question is: does it matter if we live in a simulation? What even is the difference between an AI and a living beeing? "because we have feelings" some would say, but what really are those feelings? at the end of the day they are just systems in our brains to keep our species alive.
At the end of the day i think it doesnt matter if we live in a simulation, because what we are living truely is authentic.

that game was amazing, it just seems like a normal puzzle rpg at first but its a lot more than that

oh and if you decide to buy it, do the solstice ending after the main ending, you wont regret it

I've barely played any of this game but its already amazing, messes with your files and breaks the 4th wall practically every other frame. Also please stop ruining my wallpaper whenever I open the game.

tldr.text: Overwhelmingly Positive (98%): players mostly praise the story and characters, and many also praise the music and art.
The main complaint is that the characters feel bland, though only 6% of reviews raise it.

details.text: The story and character complaint has become rare lately, with 1% of recent reviews raising it, far fewer than overall.
Players with little logged time are less positive: 84% of their reviews are positive, against 98% from those with more time logged.
